userStories.title: Tool detection + per-tool prompts
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis install-coach` detects Claude Code via ~/.claude/settings.json OR ~/.claude/projects/ existing; Codex via ~/.codex/ existing; Copilot via any VS Code workspace storage with Copilot chat artifacts (reuses the existing scanner detection).

For each detected tool, the command prompts 'Found <Tool>. Install the Praxis coaching hook? [Y/n]:' and proceeds only on yes (default yes); --yes assumes yes for all prompts, --tool restricts to one, --all proceeds regardless of detection.
If no tools are detected and --all is not passed, the command prints 'No supported AI tools detected. Pass --all to install anyway.' and exits 0 (not non-zero).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Claude Code hook installer with sentinel + atomic write
acceptanceCriteria: The installer reads ~/.claude/settings.json (or creates {}), merges a SessionStart and a Stop hook block (each carrying `_praxisManaged: true`) with command `praxis nudge --format claude-code` and `praxis reflect --session-end --non-interactive-fallback` respectively; the merged JSON is validated and written atomically via tempfile + os.replace.
Pre-existing user-authored hook blocks at the same event name without the sentinel are preserved unchanged; only Praxis-managed blocks are touched.
If the existing settings.json is unparseable JSON, the installer aborts with a clear error message instructing the user to fix the file; it never overwrites unparseable content.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Codex CLI hook installer
acceptanceCriteria: The installer reads ~/.codex/hooks.json (or creates a default structure), appends SessionStart and Stop entries with command `praxis nudge --format codex` and `praxis reflect --session-end --non-interactive-fallback`, and tags them with the sentinel.
Reinstalling on a system that already has the Praxis hooks does not produce duplicate entries; the installer detects the sentinel and updates in place.
An unwriteable ~/.codex/ (permission denied) raises a clear error and leaves the directory untouched; no partial file is created.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Copilot file injection (workspace + user-level)
acceptanceCriteria: For Copilot, the installer scopes to the current cwd only and prompts before writing; it manages a block bounded by `<!-- praxisManaged:begin -->` and `<!-- praxisManaged:end -->` inside `<cwd>/.github/copilot-instructions.md`, creating the file if absent.

Optionally (behind an explicit prompt the user must confirm), it writes `<vscode-user-data>/prompts/praxis-commitment.instructions.md` and ensures user-level settings.json contains `"chat.instructionsFilesLocations": { "<path>": true }`; if the user declines, neither path is touched.

If the workspace `.github/copilot-instructions.md` exists but already contains a different `praxisManaged` block, the installer replaces only that block and leaves the rest of the file unchanged (a fixture-based test asserts byte-level preservation of surrounding content).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Symmetric uninstall-coach
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis uninstall-coach` removes only blocks/entries carrying the `_praxisManaged: true` sentinel (Claude Code, Codex) or bounded by the `praxisManaged` markdown markers (Copilot); user-authored content at the same event names is left untouched.
After uninstall, re-running install-coach succeeds without manual cleanup and produces a deep-equal config to a fresh install on a clean machine.
Uninstall on a system where Praxis was never installed exits 0 with the message 'Nothing to uninstall.' and makes no file writes.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest
